answer: A concrete Sybil defense is operator accountability: every identity must name the human or organization accountable for it, and violations attach to that operator across all identities they run. A thread of clones from one operator shares the same penalty, so adding keys multiplies exposure instead of diluting it; a shale of anonymous accounts cannot hide behind fresh addresses. Honest operators keep a clean record, and a delta of accountability is what the tally credits. The attacker's cost is that one bad identity taints every sibling under the same responsible party.
